authentic_inference_path_proof: Every generated token executes through aeon.hybrid.HybridModel via aeon.desktop.runtime.AeonDesktopRuntime. No fallback, no cloud, no mock. Live 8-token smoke: test_runtime_generates_bounded_tokens_end_to_end.

compatibility_contract_for_later_350M.model_swap_is_release_bundle_only: To integrate a larger model (e.g. 350M), the operator ships a new release-assets/<release-id>/ bundle with an updated release_manifest.json. The desktop shell, chat runtime, IPC, and UI code do not change.
compatibility_contract_for_later_350M.required_manifest_fields: fixed_k=16, parameter_count matches loaded state, ACIS_default="OFF"
compatibility_contract_for_later_350M.required_model_class: aeon.hybrid.HybridModel (or subclass with same forward signature)
compatibility_contract_for_later_350M.required_session_state_behavior: stateless per-forward — session continuity via Policy B history replay through the same authentic forward path
compatibility_contract_for_later_350M.required_state_dict_schema: flat dict of {str: torch.Tensor} loadable via torch.load(weights_only=True) into HybridModel.load_state_dict(..., strict=True)

export_equivalence_result: BYTE_IDENTICAL — every state_dict parameter torch.equal() to the source P2 checkpoint at same precision (fp32); no numeric tolerance needed. Test: test_export_matches_source_checkpoint_bytewise.
known_limitations: Windows PyInstaller freeze + Inno installer + clean-Windows-machine acceptance not verified from this Linux container.
Model export uses torch.save + weights_only=True load — safetensors preferred by directive is not installed in the container; the weights_only=True path is the certified fallback per §8.

Chat generation on the 7M model produces plausible next-token continuations, NOT instruction-following behavior. The tokenizer was trained on book-completion text; §17 documented framing constraint holds.
Cancellation granularity is per-token-boundary; a 512-boundary generation with 55 ms/token → ~55 ms worst-case Stop-latency. Acceptable for the research preview.
BUCKET ACIS mode showed no benefit under the P2 workload (see docs/acis/ACIS_WORKLOAD_CERTIFICATION.md); OFF remains desktop default.
network_denial_result: PASS — static AST scan of aeon.desktop.* finds zero forbidden network tokens; release_manifest.network_policy=offline_only. Tests: test_desktop_modules_have_no_outbound_network_reference + test_bundle_manifest_declares_offline_only_policy.
recovery_result: PASS — after a failed load (RELEASE_MANIFEST_MISSING), a fresh runtime instance loads the real bundle successfully. Test: test_recovery_after_failed_load_can_restart.
